**1 — Scene:** A small mixed meal: chocolate cake or brownie, golden fried/toasted bread triangles, two sushi pieces, and condiments. I include all three central plates and the condiment cups; water is excluded.

**2 — Vessels:** Two side plates, approximately **20 cm** diameter each (**314 cm²**), and a larger sushi plate, approximately **26 cm** (**531 cm²**). Condiment cups are approximately **4 cm** across (**12.6 cm²** each).

**3 — Items:** Chocolate cake/brownie, French-toast-like bread triangles, two filled sushi rolls, soy sauce, pickled ginger, and wasabi. No separate oil or dressing is visibly measurable.

**4–7 — Coverage, volume, weight, and energy:** Coverage is relative to each item's own plate or cup. Heights represent the average occupied height, including the stacked bread.

| Item | Vessel coverage | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Chocolate cake/brownie | 12% | 38 × 2.6 = 99 ml | 0.9 | 89 | 420 | 374 |
| French-toast-like bread | 22% | 69 × 1.5 = 104 ml | 0.9 | 93 | 290 | 270 |
| Two sushi pieces | 6% | 32 × 2.3 = 74 ml | 0.95 | 70 | 150 | 105 |
| Soy sauce | 65% of cup | 8.2 × 0.9 = 7.4 ml | 1.0 | 7 | 55 | 4 |
| Pickled ginger | 70% of cup | 8.8 × 2.0 = 18 ml | 0.6 | 11 | 60 | 7 |
| Wasabi | 15% of cup | 1.9 × 0.9 = 1.7 ml | 1.0 | 2 | 110 | 2 |

Coverage totals are **12%, 22%, and 6%** on the respective plates, consistent with the substantial empty space.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **272 g and 762 kcal** overall. That is plausible for these small portions: the cake and fried bread provide most of the energy. Bread preparation and cake richness are the largest uncertainties.
